methodology: Projected from S93P stratified random sample (75 Evaluate + 75 Analyze, 150 total). Per-section accuracy rates applied to population counts. Confidence intervals at 95%.

evaluate_correction.description: Items currently labeled Evaluate that require reclassification to a lower cognitive level

phases.label: Phase 0 — Critical (Remember/Understand → Evaluate, 4+ tiers overstated)
phases.rationale: Definition-to-term matching masquerading as professional judgment. Most egregious category.

sections.evidence: 0/8 sampled items are true Evaluate. Dominant pattern: COSO term definition-matching (EC-005, EC-020) and control classification (EC-030). Section E has 88% labeled HO but near-zero true Evaluate.
1/4 sampled true Evaluate. Pattern: ASC rule application as judgment (P1-A-012: ASC 450 deterministic application). Small sample — per-item verification required.

phases.label: Phase 1 — High Priority (Apply → Evaluate, 2 tiers overstated)
phases.rationale: Formula substitution, known-procedure execution, or deterministic rule application labeled as evaluation.

sections.evidence: 4/8 sampled true Evaluate. Pattern: EVA formula (P1B-C-143), standard costing procedure, single-variance analysis framed as 'recommendation.'
Small per-section representation in Evaluate sample. Extrapolated from S93P per-section Analyze data showing ~44% accuracy in Pack C non-EC sections.
Pack D Section CD: 0/4 Analyze sampled items accurate — definition matching. If any Evaluate-labeled items exist in CD/DD, high likelihood of misclassification.
0/2 sampled true Evaluate. Small sample — extrapolation unreliable. Per-item verification required.

phases.label: Phase 2 — Medium Priority (Analyze → Evaluate, 1 tier overstated)
phases.rationale: Genuine analysis items that were overstated by one tier. COSO diagnosis, multi-step interpretation, variance causation — appropriate for Analyze but not Evaluate.

sections.evidence: Among the 8 EC sampled items: 2 were true Analyze (COSO diagnosis, cause-effect reasoning) but labeled Evaluate. Single-tier overstatement.
7/9 true Evaluate in ED — COSO judgment items. 2/9 were genuine Analyze overstated to Evaluate.
1 sampled item was true Analyze in an ASC-heavy judgment scenario — single-tier overstatement.

phases.label: Phase 3 — Structural Defects
phases.rationale: Items with Evaluate label that are structurally unrenderable (missing stem, choices, or correct choice).

items.issue: All fields empty — stem, choices, and correct choice absent. Structurally unrenderable. Carries question_state: Certified.
items.action: Remove from certified pool immediately. Either author content or archive.

analyze_correction.description: Items currently labeled Analyze that require reclassification to a lower cognitive level

phases.label: Phase 0 — Critical (Understand → Analyze, 2+ tiers overstated)
phases.rationale: Definition-to-term matching or single-concept classification labeled as analysis. Most common: cost management and performance management terminology.

sections.evidence: 3/3 sampled DD items are definition-to-term matching (kaizen costing, reciprocal method, normal costing). All 17 Analyze-labeled items in Pack D Section D projected as Understand.
4/4 sampled CD items are concept comprehension (common-size analysis, EVA, TQM, cost-benefit). All 10 Analyze-labeled items projected as Understand.
3/3 sampled Section A Analyze items are ASC rule application (LCNRV, CECL, depreciation) — Apply level. 0/3 true Analyze.

phases.label: Phase 1 — High Priority (Apply → Analyze, 1 tier overstated)
phases.rationale: Formula substitution, procedure execution, or deterministic rule application labeled as analysis. No cause-effect or pattern recognition.

sections.evidence: Extrapolated from S93P Pack A Analyze accuracy (8/18 = 44.4%). Formula application (A-064, A-039, B-013) is dominant pattern.
Pack C non-EC sections projected at ~44% accuracy. Fixed overhead volume variance (CC-061), EVA calculation — formula substitution.
ED: 6/11 true Analyze (COSO violation analysis). BD: 6/10 true Analyze (budget variance analysis). Remaining: Apply items framed as analysis.
3/7 sampled true Analyze. Mixed patterns: procedure application (P1B-C-108, FOH volume variance) + legitimate analysis.
1/2 sampled true Analyze. Small sample — extrapolation unreliable.

phases.label: Phase 3 — Remember-level labeled as Analyze
phases.rationale: Pure recall items with Analyze label — the most egregious single-tier misclassification category for Analyze.
